environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 API deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the origin container on port 8080. No rate limiting, no request deduplication. The service is publicly accessible via the ALB DNS name. Multiple Fargate tasks (3 replicas) serve requests, each with their own in-memory state (no shared lock across instances).
